title: Modulation of aryl hydrocarbon receptor activity by tyrosine kinase inhibitors (ponatinib and tofacitinib).
authors: Mosa, Farag E S; Alqahtani, Mohammed A; El-Ghiaty, Mahmoud A; El-Mahrouk, Sara R; Barakat, Khaled; El-Kadi, Ayman O S
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和模拟，探究酪氨酸激酶抑制剂与转录因子AhR的PAS-B结构域结合及调控机制，属于TF-DNA互作上游配体结合调控，方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系。
abstract: Ponatinib and tofacitinib, established kinase inhibitors and FDA-approved for chronic myeloid leukemia and rheumatoid arthritis, are recently undergoing investigation in diverse clinical trials for potential repurposing. The aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR), a transcription factor influencing a spectrum of physiological and pathophysiological activities, stands as a therapeutic target for numerous diseases. This study employs molecular modelling tools and in vitro assays to identify ponatinib and tofacitinib as AhR ligands, elucidating their binding and molecular interactions in the AhR PAS-B domain. Molecular docking analyses revealed that ponatinib and tofacitinib occupy the central pocket within the primary cavity, similar to AhR agonists 2,3,7,8-tetrachlorodibenzodioxin (TCDD) and (benzo[a]pyrene) B[a]P. Our simulations also showed that these compounds exhibit good stability, stabilizing many hot spots within the PAS-B domain, including the Dalpha-Ealpha loop, which serves as a regulatory element for the binding pocket. Binding energy calculations highlighted ponatinib's superior predicted affinity, revealing F295 as a crucial residue in maintaining strong interaction with the two compounds. Our in vitro data suggest that ponatinib functions as an AhR antagonist, blocking the downstream signaling of AhR pathway induced by TCDD and B[a]P. Additionally, both tofacitinib and ponatinib cause impairment in AhR-regulated CYP1A1 enzyme activity induced by potent AhR agonists. This study unveils ponatinib and tofacitinib as potential modulators of AhR, providing valuable insights into their therapeutic roles in AhR-associated diseases and enhancing our understanding of the intricate relationship between kinase inhibitors and AhR.
abstract_zh: 波纳替尼（ponatinib）和托法替尼（tofacitinib）是已确立的激酶抑制剂，获FDA批准用于治疗慢性髓性白血病和类风湿关节炎，近期正在多种临床试验中研究其潜在的药物再利用可能性。芳香烃受体（aryl hydrocarbon receptor, AhR）是一种转录因子，影响一系列生理和病理生理活动，是多种疾病的治疗靶点。本研究采用分子建模工具和体外实验，将波纳替尼和托法替尼鉴定为AhR配体，阐明它们在AhR PAS-B结构域中的结合及分子相互作用。分子对接分析显示，波纳替尼和托法替尼占据主腔内的中心口袋，类似于AhR激动剂2,3,7,8-四氯二苯并二噁英（TCDD）和苯并[a]芘（B[a]P）。我们的模拟还表明，这些化合物表现出良好的稳定性，稳定了PAS-B结构域内的多个热点区域，包括作为结合口袋调控元件的Dalpha-Ealpha环。结合能计算突显了波纳替尼预测亲和力更优，揭示F295是维持与这两种化合物强相互作用的关键残基。我们的体外数据表明，波纳替尼作为AhR拮抗剂发挥作用，阻断由TCDD和B[a]P诱导的AhR通路下游信号传导。此外，托法替尼和波纳替尼均导致强效AhR激动剂诱导的AhR调控CYP1A1酶活性受损。本研究揭示了波纳替尼和托法替尼作为AhR潜在调节剂的作用，为其在AhR相关疾病中的治疗角色提供了宝贵见解，并增进了我们对激酶抑制剂与AhR之间复杂关系的理解。
